title: Turkish Lentil Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious Turkish-inspired dish made with red lentils and pilaf. Perfect for a quick and easy weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the zesty seasoning blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed and drained lentils, pilaf, and water to the saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
